# Calling with nothing to send: this side's SID and FF, and the partner, with
# nothing either, says FQ.
@calling
< [SAMBBS-0.0-FH$]
< FF
> FQ
< *** disconnected
@check accepted=0 forwarded=0 refused=0 pending=0
